fusions.name: Hitched Ride
fusions.desc: Springs you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then deals 12 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Needling Peck
fusions.desc: Darts a quick peck that deals 3 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flutter Hop
fusions.desc: Hops you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Bounding Streak
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a hop lands on the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
